# Check the current folder-creation name and identity contract

The historical JS createFolderAndCache accepted a parent and encoded child name, required the parent to be cached, reused an existing URI object and assigned a valid parent. The current native method encodes a raw child name itself; slash/percent tests exercise that contract even though the current IDL parameter documentation still says encoded. Its wrapper checks existing children and URI collisions before creation. Preserve the actual caller/name/identity contract when changing this path; do not double-encode from stale parameter wording. No folder operation or cache performance test ran.

Scope: Folder lookup child creation and encoding.
